item.title: TIMELINE FOUNDER OF HOMELESS YOUTH SHELTER FACES HUMAN TRAFFICKING CHILD SEX CHARGES
item.description: Michael Lee Absher, the founder of a now-defunct homeless youth shelter called Only Hope WNC and a former Henderson County School Board member, has been charged with numerous sex crimes involving children in the past year. He faces one count of indecent liberties with a child, seven counts of statutory sexual offense with a person 15 years of age or younger, and three counts of human trafficking of child victims. item.title: TRANSYLVANIA MAN SENTENCED UP TO 210 YEARS FOR CHILD SEX CRIMES
item.description: A Transylvania County man was sentenced to between 150 and 210 years for child sex crimes. LOCAL NEWS According to a news release, Michael Joseph Dean was sentenced on Friday, Feb. 27, in the Superior Court after being found guilty of six counts of statutory sex offense with a child under the age of 13. item.title: PILOT SUFFERS MINOR INJURIES IN PLANE TAKEOFF AT HENDERSONVILLE AIRPORT HIGHWAY PATROL
item.description: The North Carolina State Highway Patrol was dispatched to the report of an airplane crash at approximately 4:20 p.m. on Sunday, March 1. According to Highway Patrol, a small engine experimental airplane was attempting to take off from the Hendersonville Airport at Johnson Field. While attempting to take off, the airplane struck tree tops, crashing. The pilot suffered minor cuts and scrapes. NCSHP says that the Federal Aviation Administration has been notified and will be the investigating agency
